name: apicatcher
description: Inspect JSON responses and cookies directly in the current webpage.

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8')); console.log('manifest ok');" && node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check interceptor.js
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const out = 'dist'; fs.rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true }); ['background.js','content.css','content.js','interceptor.js','manifest.json'].forEach((file) => fs.copyFileSync(file, path.join(out, file))); fs.cpSync('icons', path.join(out, 'icons'), { recursive: true }); console.log('extension bundle prepared in dist');"
